summary: Flex Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held August 5, 2026. Shareholders re-elected nine directors, reappointed Deloitte Touche LLP as auditors, approved non-binding advisory say-on-pay, authorized share issuance, and renewed a Share Purchase Mandate permitting buybacks up to 20% of outstanding shares. Matters are routine governance proposals, not special situations. No strategic transaction, activist campaign, or capital return program was announced. The share purchase mandate is a standing authorization, not a specific tender offer or buyback commitment. What to watch: potential future buyback activities under the renewed mandate.
